title: What If Half Your Brain Stayed Awake While You Slept?
subject: sleeping brain

scenes.text: What if half your brain stayed awake while you slept? In a new bed, it does.
Brown University researchers tested 35 people sleeping in a lab for two nights.
On the first night, the left hemisphere slept more lightly than the right.
That lighter half reacted more strongly to unusual beeps, and people woke faster to them.
On the second night, the difference vanished. The room had become familiar.
Some birds and marine mammals sleep this way to watch for danger. You do it for one night.
